name: Shujaabad

queries.query: Pakistan official Shujaabad land record cadastral map API Punjab Board of Revenue
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Punjab PULSE (Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement) public map and the Punjab Land Records Authority ArcGIS host. The PULSE viewer configuration exposes the Punjab_Cdastral_Maps service and maps Multan district to sublayer 36. An anonymous bounded ID-plus-geometry query succeeded; the exact WUP point query returned zero features. No ownership or other unsafe fields were requested.

queries.query: شو جا آباد پنجاب پاکستان سرکاری اراضی ریکارڈ کادستر نقشہ
queries.result: Urdu discovery found the official Punjab Land Records cadastral-map page and Punjab Zameen/PLRA references. The public cadastral page presents district, tehsil and village selection, while the PULSE viewer provides the public GIS route. No separate Shujaabad-specific first-party vector endpoint was identified.

registryCustodian.name: Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA), under the Punjab Board of Revenue / Government of Punjab; PULSE public GIS program
registryCustodian.scope: Punjab provincial land-record and cadastral-map custodian. The PULSE viewer and Punjab_Cdastral_Maps service provide indicative cadastral map layers; the viewer disclaimer says property lines are indicative and not legal boundaries.

service.name: PULSE Punjab_Cdastral_Maps ArcGIS MapServer
service.viewerConfiguration: Fetched the public viewer HTML and followed its current configuration: Multan is sublayer 36 in Punjab_Cdastral_Maps. The viewer obtains an anonymous short-lived ArcGIS token from /api/gis/token; the token was used only for public requests and not retained.

schemaAndCrs.parcelSchema: ArcGIS Feature Layer polygon; fields include OBJECTID, District, Dist_ID, Tehsil, Tehsil_ID, Mouza, Mouza_ID, M, A, QH, QH_ID, PC, PC_ID, K, SK, B, MN, Label, Karam, Khasra_ID, Remarks, Khewat_ID, Type, Shape, Shape.STArea(), Shape.STLength(), Join_Shp
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:3857 source; query output reprojected to EPSG:4326 GeoJSON

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Public viewer HTML fetched; current JavaScript/configuration inspected.
Anonymous short-lived public ArcGIS token returned; token not retained or exposed in packet.
ArcGIS REST directory returned; VendorMaps folder is listed.
Without the viewer token, service metadata returned Token Required; no bypass attempted.
With the anonymously obtained public token, Multan sublayer metadata returned polygon schema, OBJECTID native OID, and EPSG:3857 source CRS.

Exact point [29.8800934500022,71.3038174095737] queried in EPSG:4326 with where=1=1, OBJECTID-only fields, polygon geometry requested; zero features returned. This is a point result, not evidence of citywide absence.

Bounded envelope [71.20,29.80,71.40,29.96] queried in EPSG:4326 with OBJECTID-only fields, max three records, and GeoJSON output. Three polygons returned and retained in shujaabad-sample.geojson; the returned features are not claimed to contain the exact WUP point.
The guessed Pakistan host did not resolve; the discovered official page is jamabandi.punjab.gov.in and was not used as Pakistan evidence.

geometrySamples.note: Bounded Multan-layer sample; safe ID plus full polygon geometry only.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native OBJECTID only, retained as properties.id
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point and population are preserved; coordinate was not shifted.
Exact-point zero hit is not evidence of citywide absence.
The retained three polygons come from a wider bounded query and are not asserted to be Shujaabad parcels or exact-point hits.
PULSE states its digital map is based on Mussavie maps and shows indicative property lines, not legal boundaries.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, Khewat, Khasra, Mouza, or other unsafe source attributes were requested or retained in the sample.
Packet completion is research completion only and is not source integration or admission.
uncertainty: The public service's district layer is named Multan, while Shujaabad is a city/tehsil locality; citywide coverage and exact local administrative matching were not independently qualified.
The exact point may fall outside mapped polygons, in an unmapped urban area, or outside the service's current coverage; the point query alone cannot distinguish these.
No independent serial reviewer has qualified a runtime adapter.
